mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to monetary tightening, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS shows a sustained decline and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to reduced corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with a stable or decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% and UNRATE stable or decreases in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases > 1% and UNRATE is stable or decreases, and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
